title: Serbian police chief arrested in wake of election upheaval

blocks.text: BELGRADE — The prosecutor’s office in Serbia said the head of the criminal police directorate was arrested Sunday on suspicion of abuse of office, though it denied a link to momentous elections held a week ago. Marko Kricak, 42, seen as a loyalist to defeated leader Aleksandar Vucic, was accused by student groups of “brutality” in the police response to demonstrations that helped bring down Vucic’s ruling right-wing party. Student leaders last week demanded Kricak’s ouster, along with those of several other police and intelligence chiefs, as part of sweeping reforms they want to see.
